newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Basis offers mostly up again.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Basis offers mostly up again.

text.p: Basis offers in U.S. cash soybean meal markets were mostly higher again Monday as tight supplies continued to push values higher, soymeal brokers said.
Demand for soymeal in both domestic and export markets remained quite healthy despite the market's relatively high prices, cash sources said.
"They're eating it up quicker than we can ship it out," one Indiana broker said.
Supplies in the western Corn Belt were extremely tight on Monday, and basis offers skyrocketed as a result.
Soymeal basis in Kansas City was quoted Monday as $25.00 per ton over the CBOT December contract, versus the week-ago offer of $13.00 over December.
Brokers said that poultry soymeal consumption was currently near a seasonal peak as birds are fattened before the U.S. Thanksgiving and Christmas holidays.
